text: Yes, the 2022 loss was corroborated by the independent reference. The evidence shows that there was a tree-cover loss of about 0.6 hectares within the asset in 2022, as mapped by Hansen/UMD. This loss was supported by the corroboration method, which requires that a later year is observed and the JRC 2020 reference agrees on at least 50% of the event area. In this case, the JRC 2020 reference agreed on the entire event area.
